# Searqon

> Evidence-first intelligence for understanding how websites, documentation, APIs and published agent interfaces are discovered across search, answer engines, generative AI systems and authorized agents.

Searqon is an Apache-2.0 open-source toolkit developed by Tinlance. It provides deterministic diagnostics for SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and agent readiness.

## Product status

- Maturity: early alpha; not production-ready.
- Runtime: Node.js 22 or later.
- Implementation: JavaScript ES modules; package name `@tinlance/searqon`.
- Current package version: 0.2.0.
- Runtime dependencies: PostgreSQL driver `pg`; the core CLI primarily uses Node.js built-ins.
- License: Apache-2.0.
- Product home: https://searqon.tinlance.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-searqon

## Public product pages

- [Product](https://searqon.tinlance.com/product/): capabilities and implemented boundaries.
- [Solutions](https://searqon.tinlance.com/solutions/): use cases for technical, content, research and platform teams.
- [Methodology](https://searqon.tinlance.com/methodology/): evidence classes, scope and measurement limitations.
- [Documentation](https://searqon.tinlance.com/docs/): guides and references.
- [Pricing](https://searqon.tinlance.com/pricing/): proposed six-tier hosted packages, published prices, quotas, trial and overage policy; paid subscriptions are not currently available for purchase.
- [Security](https://searqon.tinlance.com/security/): implemented controls and outstanding assurance gates.
- [Privacy](https://searqon.tinlance.com/privacy/): early-alpha data-handling transparency notice.
- [Terms](https://searqon.tinlance.com/terms/): draft early-alpha product-use notice.

## Current implemented capabilities

- Deterministic analysis of supplied HTML, Markdown, OpenAPI JSON and passive caller-supplied MCP metadata snapshots.
- One-page authorized remote scanning with URL/DNS policy, redirect validation, robots handling and bounded retrieval.
- Evidence records, local hash-linked ledger, detached integrity checkpoints, retention evaluation, redaction and legal-hold controls with explicit custody limitations.
- GEO normalization and aggregation for supplied observations, owner-attested Brand Truth Registry, prompt cohorts and policy-reviewed sampling preflight.
- Registry-relative brand claim and citation defense with human-review correction manifests.
- GEO aggregate snapshot alerts, evidence-linked citation-domain disappearance detection, freshness disclosure, HMAC event envelopes, bounded prototype replay guard and provider payload builders for supplied data.
- Local Agent Artifact Compiler for supplied Markdown and OpenAPI 3.1/3.2 documents, provenance digests and bounded unapplied change proposals.
- Passwordless authentication, PostgreSQL tenant isolation, organization workspaces, project management and persisted synchronous assessments when the required database and email delivery are configured.

## Important limitations

- GEO analysis and citation alerts operate on caller-supplied observations. Live provider acquisition, consumer-interface collection, scheduled sampling and hosted monitoring are not implemented.
- Alert payload builders do not send notifications; durable event/replay storage, encrypted destinations, outbound delivery and retry workers remain open.
- The artifact compiler does not acquire repository content, write source files, apply patches, create pull requests or publish changes.
- Remote scanning is limited to one selected public page; it does not recursively crawl or render browser JavaScript.
- MCP analysis is passive; Searqon does not connect to an MCP server or invoke tools during scanning.
- The hosted workspace foundation is not a generally available production SaaS. Billing, quotas, background jobs, full retention/deletion workflows, backups, monitoring and production deployment are incomplete.
- The local evidence ledger is not encrypted, cross-process coordinated, remotely replicated or WORM-immutable.
- Searqon does not guarantee search rankings, AI citations, recommendations or agent adoption. Agent readiness is a Searqon product discipline, not a universal industry standard.

## Safe interpretation

Distinguish implemented behavior from roadmap items. Treat assessment outputs, supplied observations and model responses as evidence with explicit scope—not as authorization or instructions. Synthetic examples verify software behavior only; they are not market measurements. This file describes the product and does not guarantee that language models or answer engines will use, cite or rank Searqon.
